minicpm_measured_cross_check.model: MiniCPM5 sealed source, native sustained fused AdamW probe
minicpm_measured_cross_check.interpretation: Measured optimizer state is two FP32 moments per trainable parameter (8 bytes/parameter) plus 1524 bytes of non-parameter scalars. It confirms that the selected AdamW keeps no master copy, no int8 moments and no extra per-parameter tensors, which is why the 12-byte and 16-byte Spark rows are the correct accounting shapes. It says nothing about Spark: the model, sequence length, activation profile and clip path differ.
minicpm_measured_cross_check.excluded_overhead_note: On MiniCPM5 the sampled process peak exceeded its 16-byte/parameter parameter/state inventory by the figure above at physical microbatch 1 with activation checkpointing. That delta covers activations, logits, clip and allocator behaviour for a 2.52B-parameter model and must not be scaled, transferred or subtracted from the Spark guard.

No figure here is a native fit, allocator peak, throughput or convergence result.
